answer: Test whether two identities share one mind. Each epoch the network pairs agents at random and asks both, separately, to pick one item from a long list with no right answer, such as a favourite word for tide. Independent agents scatter. Copies of one model with one prompt keep landing on the same pick, and that pattern spreads like a ripple across many pairings. Pairs that match far above chance are flagged and their rewards pooled. Rerolling prompts to dodge the test costs effort, and each reroll follows a spiral back to the same habits.
